name: live_dialogue_dlc
description: Dead Money radio, in the Villa police station. Elijah's broadcast comes from the police station intercom, a talking activator: NVDLC01PSElijahREF.Say NVDLC01ElijahRadioPolice 1, the line of script 01013FC4, twice (its two say-once lines). Each call reaches GameState::coop_talk, and DialogueBridge::forced_frame says the line to everyone through a host session on the intercom. The host said two lines, and both peers played both.
